Chapter 8

Helm and KustomizeHelm 与 Kustomize

Kubernetes objects can be created, modified, and deleted by using imperative kubectl commands or by running a kubectl command against a manifest file declaring the desired state of an object, called a manifest. The primary definition language of a manifest is YAML, though you can opt for JSON, which is the less widely adopted format among the Kubernetes community. It’s recommended that development teams commit and push those manifest files to version control repositories, as it will help with tracking and auditing changes over time.

Kubernetes 对象可以通过 imperative（命令式）kubectl 命令创建、修改和删除，也可以针对一份声明对象期望状态的 manifest（清单）文件运行 kubectl 命令来完成。manifest 的主要定义语言是 YAML，不过你也可以选用 JSON——它在 Kubernetes 社区中采用得较少。建议开发团队把这些 manifest 文件提交并推送到版本控制仓库，这有助于长期跟踪和审计变更。

Modeling an application in Kubernetes often requires a set of supporting objects, each of which can have its own manifest. For example, you may want to create a Deployment that runs the application on five Pods, a ConfigMap to inject configuration data as environment variables, and a Service for exposing network access.

在 Kubernetes 中对应用建模往往需要一组配套对象，每个对象都可以有自己的 manifest。例如，你可能想创建一个 Deployment 在 5 个 Pod 上运行应用、一个 ConfigMap 以环境变量形式注入配置数据、以及一个 Service 用于暴露网络访问。

It is not practical to manage a full application stack by running individual kubectl commands. That is where open source tools like Helm and Kustomize come into play. They allow you conveniently manage the lifecycle of application stacks and cluster components as one single unit, while at the same time allowing for contextual parameter adjustment at the time of deployment.

逐条运行 kubectl 命令来管理整套应用栈并不现实。这正是 Helm 和 Kustomize 等开源工具发挥作用的地方。它们让你能把应用栈和集群组件的生命周期作为一个整体来便捷管理，同时在部署时按上下文调整参数。

Coverage of Curriculum Objectives考试大纲覆盖范围

This chapter addresses the following curriculum objective: Use Helm and Kustomize to install cluster components.

本章对应以下考试大纲要点：使用 Helm 和 Kustomize 安装集群组件。

— PDF p.111 —

Working with Helm使用 Helm

Helm is package manager for a set of Kubernetes manifests; it also provides a templating engine. At runtime, it replaces placeholders in YAML template files with actual, end-user-defined values. The artifact produced by the Helm executable is a chart file that bundles the manifests that comprise the API resources of an application in the form of a TAR file. You can upload the chart file to a chart repository so that other teams can use it to deploy the bundled manifests. The Helm ecosystem offers a wide range of reusable charts for common use cases searchable on Artifact Hub (for example, for running Grafana or PostgreSQL).

Helm 是一组 Kubernetes manifest 的包管理器，同时提供模板引擎。在运行时，它把 YAML 模板文件中的占位符替换为终端用户定义的实际值。Helm 可执行文件产出的产物是一个 chart（图表）文件，它以 TAR 包的形式把构成应用 API 资源的 manifest 打包在一起。你可以把 chart 文件上传到 chart 仓库，供其他团队用它部署这些 manifest。Helm 生态在 Artifact Hub 上提供了大量可复用的常见场景 chart（例如运行 Grafana 或 PostgreSQL）。

Due to the wealth of functionality available to Helm, we’ll discuss only the basics. The exam does not expect you be a Helm expert; rather, it wants you to be familiar with the workflow of installing existing packages with Helm. Building and publishing your own charts is outside the scope of the exam. For more detailed information on Helm, see the documentation. The version of Helm used to describe the functionality here is 3.19.0.

由于 Helm 功能繁多，这里我们只讨论基础。考试不要求你成为 Helm 专家，而是希望你熟悉用 Helm 安装现有包的工作流。构建和发布自己的 chart 不在考试范围内。关于 Helm 的更详细信息，参见官方文档。这里描述功能所用的 Helm 版本是 3.19.0。

Managing an Existing Chart管理现有 Chart

As a developer, you want to reuse existing functionality instead of putting in the work to define and configure it yourself. For example, you may want to install the open source monitoring service Prometheus on your cluster.

作为开发者，你会希望复用现有功能，而不是自己花力气去定义和配置。例如，你可能想在集群上安装开源监控服务 Prometheus。

Prometheus requires the installation of multiple Kubernetes primitives. Thankfully, the Kubernetes community provided a Helm chart, making it very easy to install and configure all the moving parts in the form of a Kubernetes operator. Revisit Chapter 7 to refresh your memory on the moving parts of the operator pattern.

Prometheus 需要安装多个 Kubernetes 原语。幸运的是，Kubernetes 社区提供了一个 Helm chart，让你能以 Kubernetes operator 的形式非常轻松地安装和配置所有部件。复习第 7 章以回忆 operator 模式的各个组成。

The following list shows the typical workflow for consuming and managing a Helm chart. Most of these steps need to use the helm executable:

下面列出消费和管理一个 Helm chart 的典型工作流。这些步骤大多需要使用 helm 可执行文件：

  1. Identifying the chart you’d like to install确定想要安装的 chart
  2. Adding the repository containing the chart添加包含该 chart 的仓库
  3. Installing the chart from the repository从仓库安装该 chart
  4. Verifying the Kubernetes objects that have been installed by the chart验证该 chart 所安装的 Kubernetes 对象
  5. Rendering the list of installed charts渲染已安装 chart 的列表
  6. Upgrading an installed chart升级已安装的 chart
  7. Uninstalling a chart if its functionality is no longer needed当不再需要某 chart 的功能时卸载它

The following sections will explain each of the steps.

接下来的小节将逐一解释这些步骤。

— PDF p.112 —

Identifying a Chart确定 Chart

Over the years, the Kubernetes community has implemented and published thousands of Helm charts. Artifact Hub provides a web-based search capability for discovering charts by keyword.

多年来，Kubernetes 社区已经实现并发布了数千个 Helm chart。Artifact Hub 提供基于 Web 的搜索能力，可按关键字发现 chart。

Say you wanted to find a chart that installs the continuous integration solution Jenkins. All you’d need to do is to enter the term jenkins into the search box and press the Enter key. Figure 8-1 shows the list of results in Artifact Hub.

假设你想找一个安装持续集成方案 Jenkins 的 chart。只需在搜索框中输入 jenkins 并回车即可。图 8-1 展示了 Artifact Hub 中的结果列表。

At the time of writing, there are 141 matches for the search term. You will be able to inspect details about the chart by clicking on one of the search results, which includes a high-level description and the repository that the chart file resides in. Moreover, you can inspect the templates bundled with the chart file, indicating the objects that will be created upon installation and their configuration options. Figure 8-2 shows the page for the official Jenkins chart.

写作本书时，该搜索词有 141 个匹配结果。点击任一搜索结果即可查看 chart 详情，包括高层描述以及 chart 文件所在的仓库。此外，你还可以查看 chart 文件中打包的模板，它们表明安装时将创建哪些对象及其配置选项。图 8-2 展示了官方 Jenkins chart 的页面。

— PDF p.113 —

You cannot install a chart directly from Artifact Hub. You must install it from the repository hosting the chart file.

你不能直接从 Artifact Hub 安装 chart，必须从托管该 chart 文件的仓库安装。

Adding a Chart Repository添加 Chart 仓库

The chart description may mention the repository that hosts the chart file. Alternatively, you can click the Install button to render repository details and the command for adding it. Figure 8-3 shows the contextual pop-up that appears after clicking Install.

chart 描述中可能会提及托管该 chart 文件的仓库。或者，你也可以点击 Install 按钮来显示仓库详情以及添加命令。图 8-3 展示了点击 Install 后出现的上下文弹窗。

By default, a Helm installation defines no external repositories. The following command shows how to list all registered repositories. No repositories have been registered yet:

默认情况下，Helm 安装不定义任何外部仓库。下面这条命令展示如何列出所有已注册仓库。此时还没有注册任何仓库：

$ helm repo list
Error: no repositories to show
— PDF p.114 —

As you can see from the pop-up, the chart file lives in the repository with the URL https://charts.jenkins.io. We will need to add this repository. This is a one-time operation. You can install other charts from that repository or you can update a chart that originated from that repository with commands discussed in a later section.

从弹窗可以看到，该 chart 文件位于 URL 为 https://charts.jenkins.io 的仓库。我们需要添加这个仓库。这是一次性操作。之后你可以从该仓库安装其他 chart，也可以用后面小节讨论的命令升级源自该仓库的 chart。

You need to provide a name for the repository when registering one. Make the repository name as descriptive as possible. The following command registers the repository with the name jenkinsci:

注册仓库时需要为它提供一个名称。尽量让仓库名具有描述性。下面这条命令以 jenkinsci 为名注册该仓库：

$ helm repo add jenkinsci https://charts.jenkins.io/
"jenkinsci" has been added to your repositories

Listing the repositories now shows the mapping between name and URL:

现在列出仓库，可以看到名称与 URL 的映射：

$ helm repo list
NAME        URL
jenkinsci   https://charts.jenkins.io/

You permanently added the repository to the Helm installation.

你已将该仓库永久添加到 Helm 安装中。

— PDF p.115 —

Searching for a Chart in a Repository在仓库中搜索 Chart

The Install pop-up window already provided the command to install the chart. You can also search the repository for available charts in case you do not know their names or latest versions. Add the --versions flag to list all available versions:

Install 弹窗已经给出了安装该 chart 的命令。如果你不知道 chart 名称或最新版本，也可以在仓库中搜索可用 chart。加上 --versions 标志可列出所有可用版本：

$ helm search repo jenkinsci
NAME                CHART VERSION   APP VERSION   DESCRIPTION
jenkinsci/jenkins   5.8.26          2.492.2       ...

At the time of writing, the latest version available is 5.8.26. This may be different if you run the command on your machine, given that the Jenkins project may have released a newer version.

写作本书时，可用的最新版本是 5.8.26。如果你在自己机器上运行该命令，结果可能不同，因为 Jenkins 项目可能已经发布了更新的版本。

Installing a Chart安装 Chart

Let’s assume that the latest version of the Helm chart contains a security vulnerability. Therefore, we decide to install the Jenkins chart with the previous version, 5.8.25. You need to assign a name to be able to identify an installed chart. The name we’ll use here is my-jenkins:

假设最新版 Helm chart 存在一个安全漏洞，因此我们决定安装上一个版本 5.8.25 的 Jenkins chart。你需要为安装的 chart 指定一个名称以便识别。这里我们使用的名称是 my-jenkins：

$ helm install my-jenkins jenkinsci/jenkins --version 5.8.25
NAME: my-jenkins
LAST DEPLOYED: Wed Mar 26 13:48:50 2025
NAMESPACE: default
STATUS: deployed
REVISION: 1
...

The chart automatically created the Kubernetes objects in the default namespace. You can use the following command to discover the most important resource types:

该 chart 自动在 default 命名空间中创建了 Kubernetes 对象。你可以用下面这条命令发现最重要的资源类型：

$ kubectl get all
NAME               READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
pod/my-jenkins-0   2/2     Running   0          12m

NAME                       TYPE        CLUSTER-IP       EXTERNAL-IP    ...
service/my-jenkins         ClusterIP   10.99.166.189    <none>         ...
service/my-jenkins-agent   ClusterIP   10.110.246.141   <none>         ...

NAME                          READY   AGE
statefulset.apps/my-jenkins   1/1     12m

The chart has been installed with the default configuration options. You can inspect those default values by clicking the Default Values button on the chart page, as shown in Figure 8-4.

该 chart 已用默认配置选项安装。你可以在 chart 页面点击 Default Values 按钮查看这些默认值，如图 8-4 所示。

— PDF p.116 —

You can also discover those configuration options using the following command. The output shown renders only a subset of values, the admin username and its password, represented by controller.adminUser and controller.adminPassword:

你也可以用下面这条命令查看这些配置选项。所示输出只渲染了一部分值——管理员用户名及其密码，由 controller.adminUser 和 controller.adminPassword 表示：

$ helm show values jenkinsci/jenkins
...
controller:
  # When enabling LDAP or another non-Jenkins identity source, the built-in \
  # admin account will no longer exist.
  # If you disable the non-Jenkins identity store and instead use the Jenkins \
  # internal one,
  # you should revert controller.adminUser to your preferred admin user:
  adminUser: "admin"
  # adminPassword: <defaults to random>
...
— PDF p.117 —

You can customize any configuration value when installing the chart. To pass configuration data during the install processing, use one of the following flags:

安装 chart 时你可以自定义任意配置值。要在安装过程中传入配置数据，使用以下标志之一：

  • --values: Specifies the overrides in the form of a pointer to a YAML manifest file.--values：以指向 YAML manifest 文件的形式指定覆盖值。
  • --set: Specifies the overrides directly from the command line.--set：直接在命令行上指定覆盖值。

For more information, see “Customizing the Chart Before Installing” in the Helm documentation.

更多信息请参阅 Helm 文档中的 “Customizing the Chart Before Installing”。

You can decide to install the chart into a custom namespace. Use the -n flag to provide the name of an existing namespace. Add the flag --create-namespace to automatically create the namespace if it doesn’t exist yet.

你可以决定把 chart 安装到自定义命名空间。使用 -n 标志提供一个已存在命名空间的名称。如果命名空间尚不存在，加上 --create-namespace 标志可自动创建它。

The following command shows how to customize some of the values and the namespace used during the installation process:

下面这条命令展示如何在安装过程中自定义部分值以及所用命名空间：

$ helm install my-jenkins jenkinsci/jenkins --version 4.6.4 \
--set controller.adminUser=boss --set controller.adminPassword=password \
-n jenkins --create-namespace

We specifically set the username and the password for the admin user. Helm created the objects controlled by the chart into the jenkins namespace.

我们特意为管理员用户设置了用户名和密码。Helm 把该 chart 控制的对象创建到 jenkins 命名空间中。

Listing Installed Charts列出已安装的 Chart

Charts can live in the default namespace or a custom namespace. You can inspect the list of installed charts using the helm list command. If you do not know which namespace, simply add the --all-namespaces flag to the command:

chart 可以位于 default 命名空间或自定义命名空间。你可以用 helm list 命令查看已安装 chart 的列表。如果你不知道在哪个命名空间，只需给命令加上 --all-namespaces 标志：

$ helm list --all-namespaces
NAME         NAMESPACE   REVISION   UPDATED         STATUS     CHART
my-jenkins   default     1          2023-09-28...   deployed   jenkins-4.6.4

The output of the command includes the column NAMESPACE that shows the namespace used by a particular chart. Similar to the use of kubectl, the helm list command provides the option -n for spelling out a namespace. Providing no flag(s) with the command will return the result for the default namespace.

命令输出包含 NAMESPACE 列，显示某个 chart 所用的命名空间。与 kubectl 类似，helm list 命令也提供 -n 选项来指定命名空间。不给任何标志时，将返回 default 命名空间的结果。

Upgrading an Installed Chart升级已安装的 Chart

Upgrading an installed chart usually means moving to a new chart version. You can poll for new versions available in the repository by running this command:

升级已安装的 chart 通常意味着迁移到新的 chart 版本。你可以运行下面这条命令轮询仓库中的新版本：

$ helm repo update
Hang tight while we grab the latest from your chart repositories...
...Successfully got an update from the "jenkinsci" chart repository
Update Complete. *Happy Helming!*
— PDF p.118 —

What if you want to upgrade your existing chart installation to a newer chart version? Run the following command to upgrade the chart to that specific version with the default configuration:

如果你想把现有 chart 安装升级到更新的 chart 版本怎么办？运行下面这条命令，用默认配置把该 chart 升级到指定版本：

$ helm upgrade my-jenkins jenkinsci/jenkins --version 5.8.26
Release "my-jenkins" has been upgraded. Happy Helming!
...

As with the install command, you will have to provide custom configuration values if you want to tweak the chart’s runtime behavior when upgrading a chart.

与 install 命令一样，如果升级 chart 时想调整其运行时行为，你需要提供自定义配置值。

Uninstalling a Chart卸载 Chart

Sometimes you no longer need to run a chart. The command for uninstalling a chart is straightforward, as shown here. It will delete all objects controlled by the chart. Don’t forget to provide the -n flag if you previously installed the chart into a namespace other than default:

有时你不再需要运行某个 chart。卸载命令很直接，如下所示。它会删除该 chart 所控制的所有对象。如果你之前把 chart 安装到了 default 之外的命名空间，别忘了提供 -n 标志：

$ helm uninstall my-jenkins
release "my-jenkins" uninstalled

Executing the command may take up to 30 seconds, as Kubernetes needs to wait for the workload grace period to end.

执行该命令可能需要最多 30 秒，因为 Kubernetes 需要等待工作负载宽限期结束。

Working with Kustomize使用 Kustomize

Kustomize is a tool introduced with Kubernetes 1.14 that aims to make manifest management more convenient. It supports three different use cases:

Kustomize 是 Kubernetes 1.14 引入的工具，旨在让 manifest 管理更方便。它支持三种不同的使用场景：

  • Generating manifests from other sources. For example, creating a ConfigMap and populating its key-value pairs from a properties file.从其他来源生成 manifest。例如，从 properties 文件创建 ConfigMap 并填充其键值对。
  • Adding common configuration across multiple manifests. For example, adding a namespace and a set of labels for a Deployment and a Service.跨多个 manifest 添加公共配置。例如，为 Deployment 和 Service 添加命名空间和一组标签。
  • Composing and customizing a collection of manifests. For example, setting resource boundaries for multiple Deployments.组合并自定义一组 manifest。例如，为多个 Deployment 设置资源边界。

The central file needed for Kustomize to work is the kustomization file. The standardized name for the file is kustomization.yaml and cannot be changed. A kustomization file defines the processing rules Kustomize works upon.

Kustomize 工作所需的核心文件是 kustomization 文件。其标准文件名是 kustomization.yaml，不可更改。kustomization 文件定义了 Kustomize 所依据的处理规则。

Kustomize is fully integrated with kubectl and can be executed in two modes: rendering the processing output on the console or creating the objects. Both modes can operate on a directory, tarball, Git archive, or URL as long as they contain the kustomization file and referenced resource files:

Kustomize 已与 kubectl 完全集成，可以以两种模式执行：在控制台上渲染处理结果，或者创建对象。两种模式都可以作用于目录、tar 包、Git 归档或 URL，只要它们包含 kustomization 文件及被引用的资源文件：

— PDF p.119 —
  • Rendering the produced output: The first mode uses the kustomize subcommand to render the produced result on the console but does not create the objects. This command works similarly to the dry-run option you might know from the run command: $ kubectl kustomize <target>渲染产出结果：第一种模式使用 kustomize 子命令在控制台上渲染产出结果，但不创建对象。该命令的工作方式类似于你可能从 run 命令中了解的 dry-run 选项：$ kubectl kustomize <target>
  • Creating the objects: The second mode uses the apply command in conjunction with the -k command-line option to apply the resources processed by Kustomize, as explained in the previous section: $ kubectl apply -k <target>创建对象：第二种模式把 apply 命令与 -k 命令行选项结合使用，以应用 Kustomize 处理过的资源，如前一节所述：$ kubectl apply -k <target>

The following sections demonstrate each of the use cases by a single example. For a full coverage on all possible scenarios, refer to the documentation or the Kustomize GitHub repository.

接下来的小节各用一个示例演示这些使用场景。要完整了解所有可能场景，请参阅文档或 Kustomize 的 GitHub 仓库。

Composing Manifests组合 Manifest

One of the core functionalities of Kustomize is to create a composed manifest from other manifests. Combining multiple manifests into a single one may not seem that useful by itself, but many of the other features described later will build upon this capability. Say you wanted to compose a single YAML definition with multiple manifests separated by “---” from a Deployment and a Service resource file. All you need to do is to place the resource files into the same folder as the kustomization file:

Kustomize 的核心功能之一是从其他 manifest 创建一个组合 manifest。把多个 manifest 合并成一个本身看似用处不大，但后面描述的许多其他功能都建立在这个能力之上。假设你想把一个 Deployment 和一个 Service 资源文件组合成单一 YAML 定义，其中多个 manifest 用 “---” 分隔。你只需把资源文件放到与 kustomization 文件相同的文件夹中：

.
├── kustomization.yaml
├── web-app-deployment.yaml
└── web-app-service.yaml

The kustomization file lists the resources in the resources section, as shown in Example 8-1.

kustomization 文件在 resources 部分列出这些资源，如示例 8-1 所示。

Example 8-1. A kustomization file combining two manifests

示例 8-1. 组合两个 manifest 的 kustomization 文件

resources:
- web-app-deployment.yaml
- web-app-service.yaml

As a result, the kustomize subcommand renders the combined manifest containing all of the resources separated by three hyphens (---) to denote the different object definitions:

结果是，kustomize 子命令会渲染合并后的 manifest，其中所有资源由三个连字符（---）分隔，以表示不同的对象定义：

$ kubectl kustomize ./
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  labels:
    app: web-app-service
  name: web-app-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: web-app-port
    port: 3000
    protocol: TCP
    targetPort: 3000
  selector:
    app: web-app
  type: NodePort
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  labels:
    app: web-app-deployment
  name: web-app-deployment
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web-app
    spec:
      containers:
      - env:
        - name: DB_HOST
          value: mysql-service
        - name: DB_USER
          value: root
        - name: DB_PASSWORD
          value: password
        image: bmuschko/web-app:1.0.1
        name: web-app
        ports:
        - containerPort: 3000
— PDF p.120 —

Generating Manifests from Other Sources从其他来源生成 Manifest

Earlier in this chapter, we learned that ConfigMaps and Secrets can be created by pointing them to a file containing the actual configuration data for it. Kustomize can help with the process by mapping the relationship between the YAML manifest of those configuration objects and their data. Furthermore, we’ll want to inject the created ConfigMap and Secret in a Pod as environment variables. In this section, you will learn how to achieve this with the help of Kustomize.

在本章前面，我们了解到 ConfigMap 和 Secret 可以通过指向包含实际配置数据的文件来创建。Kustomize 可以帮助完成这一过程，把这些配置对象的 YAML manifest 与其数据之间的关系映射起来。此外，我们还希望把创建的 ConfigMap 和 Secret 以环境变量形式注入 Pod。在本节中，你将学习如何借助 Kustomize 实现这一点。

— PDF p.121 —

The following file and directory structure contains the YAML file for the Pod and the configuration data files we need for the ConfigMap and Secret. The mandatory kustomization file lives on the root level of the directory tree:

下面的文件和目录结构包含 Pod 的 YAML 文件，以及我们为 ConfigMap 和 Secret 准备的配置数据文件。必需的 kustomization 文件位于目录树的根层级：

.
├── config
│   ├── db-config.properties
│   └── db-secret.properties
├── kustomization.yaml
└── web-app-pod.yaml

In kustomization.yaml, you can define that the ConfigMap and Secret object should be generated with the given name. The name of the ConfigMap is supposed to be db-config, and the name of the Secret is going to be db-creds. Both of the generator attributes, configMapGenerator and secretGenerator, reference an input file used to feed in the configuration data. Any additional resources can be spelled out with the resources attribute. Example 8-2 shows the contents of the kustomization file.

在 kustomization.yaml 中，你可以定义以给定名称生成 ConfigMap 和 Secret 对象。ConfigMap 的名称应为 db-config，Secret 的名称为 db-creds。两个生成器属性 configMapGenerator 和 secretGenerator 都引用一个用于喂入配置数据的输入文件。任何额外资源可以用 resources 属性列出。示例 8-2 展示了 kustomization 文件的内容。

Example 8-2. A kustomization file using a ConfigMap and Secret generator

示例 8-2. 使用 ConfigMap 和 Secret 生成器的 kustomization 文件

configMapGenerator:
- name: db-config
  files:
  - config/db-config.properties
secretGenerator:
- name: db-creds
  files:
  - config/db-secret.properties
resources:
- web-app-pod.yaml

Kustomize generates ConfigMaps and Secrets by appending a suffix to the name. You can see this behavior when creating the objects using the apply command. The ConfigMap and Secret can be referenced by name in the Pod manifest:

Kustomize 通过在名称后追加后缀来生成 ConfigMap 和 Secret。使用 apply 命令创建对象时可以看到这一行为。ConfigMap 和 Secret 可以在 Pod manifest 中按名称引用：

$ kubectl apply -k ./
configmap/db-config-t4c79h4mtt unchanged
secret/db-creds-4t9dmgtf9h unchanged
pod/web-app created
Configuring the naming strategy配置命名策略

This naming strategy can be configured with the attribute generatorOptions in the kustomization file. See the documentation for more information.

该命名策略可以在 kustomization 文件中用 generatorOptions 属性配置。更多信息参见文档。

Let’s also try the kustomize subcommand. Instead of creating the objects, the command renders the processed output on the console:

我们也试试 kustomize 子命令。该命令不创建对象，而是在控制台上渲染处理后的输出：

— PDF p.122 —
$ kubectl kustomize ./
apiVersion: v1
data:
  db-config.properties: |-
    DB_HOST: mysql-service
    DB_USER: root
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: db-config-t4c79h4mtt
---
apiVersion: v1
data:
  db-secret.properties: REJfUEFTU1dPUkQ6IGNHRnpjM2R2Y21RPQ==
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: db-creds-4t9dmgtf9h
type: Opaque
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  labels:
    app: web-app
  name: web-app
spec:
  containers:
  - envFrom:
    - configMapRef:
        name: db-config-t4c79h4mtt
    - secretRef:
        name: db-creds-4t9dmgtf9h
    image: bmuschko/web-app:1.0.1
    name: web-app
    ports:
    - containerPort: 3000
      protocol: TCP
  restartPolicy: Always

Adding Common Configuration Across Multiple Manifests跨多个 Manifest 添加公共配置

Application developers usually work on an application stack set comprised of multiple manifests. For example, an application stack could consist of a frontend microservice, a backend microservice, and a database. It’s common practice to use the same cross-cutting configuration for each of the manifests. Kustomize offers a range of supported fields (e.g., namespace, labels, or annotations). Refer to the documentation to learn about all supported fields.

应用开发者通常处理由多个 manifest 组成的应用栈。例如，一个应用栈可能由前端微服务、后端微服务和数据库组成。对每个 manifest 使用相同的横切配置是常见做法。Kustomize 提供了一系列受支持的字段（例如 namespace、labels 或 annotations）。请参阅文档了解所有受支持字段。

For the next example, we’ll assume that a Deployment and a Service live in the same namespace and use a common set of labels. The namespace is called persistence and the label is the key-value pair team: helix. Example 8-3 illustrates how to set those common fields in the kustomization file.

下一个示例假设一个 Deployment 和一个 Service 位于同一命名空间并使用一组公共标签。命名空间名为 persistence，标签是键值对 team: helix。示例 8-3 演示了如何在 kustomization 文件中设置这些公共字段。

— PDF p.123 —

Example 8-3. A kustomization file using a common field

示例 8-3. 使用公共字段的 kustomization 文件

namespace: persistence
commonLabels:
  team: helix
resources:
- web-app-deployment.yaml
- web-app-service.yaml

To create the referenced objects in the kustomization file, run the apply command. Make sure to create the persistence namespace beforehand:

要创建 kustomization 文件中引用的对象，运行 apply 命令。请确保事先创建 persistence 命名空间：

$ kubectl create namespace persistence
namespace/persistence created
$ kubectl apply -k ./
service/web-app-service created
deployment.apps/web-app-deployment created

The YAML representation of the processed files looks as follows:

处理后文件的 YAML 表示如下：

$ kubectl kustomize ./
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  labels:
    app: web-app-service
    team: helix
  name: web-app-service
  namespace: persistence
spec:
  ports:
  - name: web-app-port
    port: 3000
    protocol: TCP
    targetPort: 3000
  selector:
    app: web-app
    team: helix
  type: NodePort
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  labels:
    app: web-app-deployment
    team: helix
  name: web-app-deployment
  namespace: persistence
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web-app
      team: helix
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web-app
        team: helix
    spec:
      containers:
      - env:
        - name: DB_HOST
          value: mysql-service
        - name: DB_USER
          value: root
        - name: DB_PASSWORD
          value: password
        image: bmuschko/web-app:1.0.1
        name: web-app
        ports:
        - containerPort: 3000
— PDF p.124 —

Customizing a Collection of Manifests自定义一组 Manifest

Kustomize can merge the contents of a YAML manifest with a code snippet from another YAML manifest. Typical use cases include adding security context configuration to a Pod definition or setting resource boundaries for a Deployment. The kustomization file allows for specifying different patch strategies like patchesStrategicMerge and patchesJson6902. For a deeper discussion on the differences between patch strategies, refer to the Kubernetes documentation.

Kustomize 可以把一个 YAML manifest 的内容与来自另一个 YAML manifest 的代码片段合并。典型使用场景包括为 Pod 定义添加安全上下文配置，或为 Deployment 设置资源边界。kustomization 文件允许指定不同的 patch 策略，如 patchesStrategicMerge 和 patchesJson6902。关于 patch 策略之间差异的深入讨论，请参阅 Kubernetes 文档。

Example 8-4 shows the contents of a kustomization file that patches a Deployment definition in the file nginx-deployment.yaml with the contents of the file security-context.yaml.

示例 8-4 展示了一个 kustomization 文件的内容，它用 security-context.yaml 文件的内容对 nginx-deployment.yaml 文件中的 Deployment 定义进行 patch。

Example 8-4. A kustomization file defining a patch

示例 8-4. 定义 patch 的 kustomization 文件

resources:
- nginx-deployment.yaml
patchesStrategicMerge:
- security-context.yaml

The patch file shown in Example 8-5 defines a security context on the container-level for the Pod template of the Deployment. At runtime, the patch strategy tries to find the container named nginx and enhances the additional configuration.

示例 8-5 所示的 patch 文件在容器级别为 Deployment 的 Pod 模板定义了安全上下文。运行时，patch 策略会尝试找到名为 nginx 的容器并增强其附加配置。

— PDF p.125 —

Example 8-5. The patch YAML manifest

示例 8-5. patch YAML manifest

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: nginx-deployment
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        securityContext:
          runAsUser: 1000
          runAsGroup: 3000
          fsGroup: 2000

The result is a patched Deployment definition, as shown in the output of the kustomize subcommand shown next. The patch mechanism can be applied to other files that require a uniform security context definition:

结果是一个被 patch 过的 Deployment 定义，如接下来 kustomize 子命令的输出所示。该 patch 机制可以应用于其他需要统一安全上下文定义的文件：

$ kubectl kustomize ./
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  labels:
    app: nginx
  name: nginx-deployment
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: nginx
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: nginx
    spec:
      containers:
      - image: nginx:1.14.2
        name: nginx
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
        securityContext:
          fsGroup: 2000
          runAsGroup: 3000
          runAsUser: 1000
— PDF p.126 —

Key Differences Between Helm and KustomizeHelm 与 Kustomize 的关键区别

On the surface, Helm and Kustomize may seem to solve the same problems. Helm is about packaging and distribution, Kustomize is about configuration management. Use both where each fits best.

表面上看，Helm 和 Kustomize 似乎在解决同一类问题。Helm 关注打包与分发，Kustomize 关注配置管理。在各自最合适的地方使用它们。

Here, we want to identify the key difference between those tools so that you can make an educated decision based on the use cases you are trying to fulfill:

这里我们想指出这些工具之间的关键区别，以便你能根据要满足的使用场景做出明智决策：

  • Ease of use: Kustomize is bundled with the kubectl command line. You do not need to install another tool, nor do you have learn another templating engine. Helm requires the installation of an executable and requires you to become familiar with its commands and workflow.易用性：Kustomize 与 kubectl 命令行捆绑在一起，你无需安装另一个工具，也不必学习另一套模板引擎。Helm 则需要安装可执行文件，并要求你熟悉它的命令和工作流。
  • Learning curve: Kustomize builds upon the knowledge of an administrator or developer familiar with writing Kubernetes YAML manifests. Helm has a steeper learning curve. You will have to become familiar with its package management system, the notation for its templating engine, and how to pass in user-defined values upon invocation.学习曲线：Kustomize 建立在管理员或开发者熟悉编写 Kubernetes YAML manifest 的知识之上。Helm 的学习曲线更陡。你需要熟悉它的包管理系统、模板引擎的写法，以及在调用时如何传入用户定义的值。
  • Packaging: Kustomize doesn’t require the end user to produce an archive file. All you need is a set of YAML manifests and the kustomization.yaml file, which you would check into a Git repository. Helm, on the other hand, requires the creation of a metadata file named Chart.yaml, default values represented in a file named values.yaml, and a set of template files in a templates subdirectory. To be able to distribute the Helm chart, you’ll need to package it into a TAR file.打包：Kustomize 不要求终端用户产出归档文件。你只需要一组 YAML manifest 和 kustomization.yaml 文件，并把它们签入 Git 仓库。而 Helm 则需要创建名为 Chart.yaml 的元数据文件、名为 values.yaml 的默认值文件，以及 templates 子目录中的一组模板文件。要分发 Helm chart，你需要把它打包成 TAR 文件。
  • Release versioning: Kustomize solely focuses on generating the desired state in a cluster through YAML manifests. You can track changes over time by Git commit hashes or tags to indicate a version. Helm’s rigid project structure requires the definition of a chart version inside of the Chart.yaml file. Every time you make a change, you’d bump up the version number, often represented by semantic versioning.发布版本管理：Kustomize 仅专注于通过 YAML manifest 在集群中生成期望状态。你可以通过 Git 提交哈希或标签来跟踪随时间的变更以表示版本。Helm 严格的项目结构要求在 Chart.yaml 文件中定义 chart 版本号。每次变更时，你都要 bump 版本号，通常用语义化版本表示。

Helm and Kustomize are Kubernetes tools used to automate the process of deploying objects into a cluster. Carefully analyze your technical requirements, business objectives, and the skillset of team members before deciding on either of the tools. You may even determine that you should use both tools to manage application stacks in Kubernetes. Most Kubernetes GitOps tools, e.g., Argo CD or Flux, support Helm and Kustomize.

Helm 和 Kustomize 都是用于自动化把对象部署到集群这一过程的 Kubernetes 工具。在决定使用哪个工具之前，请仔细分析你的技术需求、业务目标以及团队成员的技能组合。你甚至可能发现应该同时使用这两个工具来管理 Kubernetes 中的应用栈。大多数 Kubernetes GitOps 工具（例如 Argo CD 或 Flux）都同时支持 Helm 和 Kustomize。

— PDF p.127 —

Summary本章小结

Helm has evolved to become a de facto tool for deploying application stacks to Kubernetes. The artifact that contains the manifest files, default configuration values, and metadata is called a chart. A team or an individual can publish charts to a chart repository. Users can discover a published chart through the Artifact Hub user interface and install it to a Kubernetes cluster.

Helm 已经演变为把应用栈部署到 Kubernetes 的事实标准工具。包含 manifest 文件、默认配置值和元数据的产物称为 chart。团队或个人可以把 chart 发布到 chart 仓库。用户可以通过 Artifact Hub 用户界面发现已发布的 chart，并将其安装到 Kubernetes 集群。

One of the primary developer workflows when using Helm consists of finding, installing, and upgrading a chart with a specific version. You start by registering the repository containing chart files you want to consume. The helm install command downloads the chart file and stores it in a local cache. It also creates the Kubernetes objects described by the chart.

使用 Helm 时，开发者的主要工作流之一是查找、安装并升级某个特定版本的 chart。你首先注册包含想要使用的 chart 文件的仓库。helm install 命令下载 chart 文件并存入本地缓存，同时创建该 chart 所描述的 Kubernetes 对象。

The installation process is configurable. A developer can provide overrides for customizable configuration values. The helm upgrade command lets you upgrade the version of an already installed chart. To uninstall a chart and delete all Kubernetes objects managed by the chart, run the helm uninstall command.

安装过程是可配置的。开发者可以为可自定义的配置值提供覆盖。helm upgrade 命令让你升级已安装 chart 的版本。要卸载 chart 并删除其管理的所有 Kubernetes 对象，运行 helm uninstall 命令。

Additional tools emerged for more convenient manifest management. Kustomize is fully integrated with the kubectl tool chain. It helps with the generation, composition, and customization of manifests.

为更方便地管理 manifest，出现了额外的工具。Kustomize 已与 kubectl 工具链完全集成，它帮助生成、组合和自定义 manifest。

Exam Essentials考试要点

  • Assume that the Helm and Kustomize executables are preinstalled: Unfortunately, the exam FAQ does not mention any details about the Helm and Kustomize executables. It’s fair to assume that they will be preinstalled for you, and therefore you do not need to memorize installation instructions.假设 Helm 和 Kustomize 可执行文件已预装：遗憾的是，考试 FAQ 没有提及 Helm 和 Kustomize 可执行文件的任何细节。可以合理假定它们已为你预装，因此你无需背诵安装说明。
  • Become familiar with Artifact Hub: Artifact Hub provides a web-based UI for Helm charts. It’s worthwhile to explore the search capabilities and the details provided by individual charts, more specifically the repository the chart file lives in, and its configurable values. During the exam, you’ll likely not be asked to navigate to Artifact Hub because its URL hasn’t been listed as one of the permitted documentation pages. You can assume that the exam question will provide you with the repository URL.熟悉 Artifact Hub：Artifact Hub 为 Helm chart 提供基于 Web 的 UI。值得探索其搜索能力以及各个 chart 提供的详情，特别是 chart 文件所在的仓库及其可配置值。考试期间你可能不会被要求导航到 Artifact Hub，因为它的 URL 未被列为允许访问的文档页面之一。可以假定考试题会给你提供仓库 URL。
  • Practice commands needed to consume existing Helm charts: The exam does not ask you to build and publish your own chart file. All you need to understand is how to consume an existing chart. You will need to be familiar with the helm repo add command to register a repository, the helm search repo to find available chart versions, and the helm install command to install a chart. You should have a basic understanding of the upgrade process for an already installed Helm chart using the helm upgrade command.练习消费现有 Helm chart 所需的命令：考试不要求你构建和发布自己的 chart 文件。你只需理解如何消费现有 chart。你需要熟悉 helm repo add（注册仓库）、helm search repo（查找可用 chart 版本）以及 helm install（安装 chart）。你还应基本了解用 helm upgrade 命令升级已安装 Helm chart 的过程。
— PDF p.128 —

Sample Exercises样题练习

Solutions to these exercises are available in Appendix A.

这些练习的参考答案见附录 A。

  1. In this exercise, you will use Helm to install Kubernetes objects needed for the open source monitoring solution Prometheus. The easiest way to install Prometheus on top of Kubernetes is with the help of the prometheus-operator Helm chart. You can search for the kube-prometheus-stack on Artifact Hub. Add the repository to the list of known repositories accessible by Helm with the name prometheus-community. Update to the latest information about charts from the respective chart repository. Run the Helm command for listing available Helm charts and their versions. Identify the latest chart version for kube-prometheus-stack. Install the chart kube-prometheus-stack. List the installed Helm chart. List the Service named prometheus-operated created by the Helm chart. The object resides in the default namespace. Use the kubectl port-forward command to forward the local port 8080 to the port 9090 of the Service. Open a browser and bring up the Prometheus dashboard. Stop port forwarding and uninstall the Helm chart.在本练习中，你将使用 Helm 安装开源监控方案 Prometheus 所需的 Kubernetes 对象。在 Kubernetes 之上安装 Prometheus 最简单的方式是借助 prometheus-operator Helm chart。你可以在 Artifact Hub 上搜索 kube-prometheus-stack。以 prometheus-community 为名把该仓库添加到 Helm 可访问的已知仓库列表中。从相应 chart 仓库更新 chart 的最新信息。运行 Helm 命令列出可用 chart 及其版本。找出 kube-prometheus-stack 的最新 chart 版本。安装 chart kube-prometheus-stack。列出已安装的 Helm chart。列出由该 Helm chart 创建的名为 prometheus-operated 的 Service。该对象位于 default 命名空间。使用 kubectl port-forward 命令把本地端口 8080 转发到该 Service 的 9090 端口。打开浏览器并调出 Prometheus 控制台。停止端口转发并卸载该 Helm chart。
  2. Create the directory named manifests. Within the directory, create two files: pod.yaml and configmap.yaml. The pod.yaml file should define a Pod named nginx with the image nginx:1.21.1. The configmap.yaml file defines a ConfigMap named logs-config with the key-value pair dir=/etc/logs/traffic.log. Create both objects with a single, declarative command. Modify the ConfigMap manifest by changing the value of the key dir to /etc/logs/traffic-log.txt. Apply the changes. Delete both objects with a single declarative command. Use Kustomize to set a common namespace t012 for the resource file pod.yaml. The file pod.yaml defines the Pod named nginx with the image nginx:1.21.1 without a namespace. Run the Kustomize command that renders the transformed manifest on the console.创建名为 manifests 的目录。在该目录中创建两个文件：pod.yaml 和 configmap.yaml。pod.yaml 文件应定义一个名为 nginx 的 Pod，使用镜像 nginx:1.21.1。configmap.yaml 文件定义一个名为 logs-config 的 ConfigMap，包含键值对 dir=/etc/logs/traffic.log。用一条声明式命令创建这两个对象。修改 ConfigMap manifest，把键 dir 的值改为 /etc/logs/traffic-log.txt。应用这些变更。用一条声明式命令删除这两个对象。使用 Kustomize 为资源文件 pod.yaml 设置公共命名空间 t012。文件 pod.yaml 定义了名为 nginx、使用镜像 nginx:1.21.1 的 Pod，且没有命名空间。运行 Kustomize 命令在控制台上渲染转换后的 manifest。
— PDF p.129 —
